Created [ARCH-001.md](/tmp/dfai-architecture-extra-a9zrt7nu/project/docs/specs/arch/ARCH-001.md) for PRD-001 v1 with four proposed components and eight open decisions.

- **PASS:** Structure, requirement links, and coverage of all six active requirements.
- **BLOCKED:** Exact host model and session IDs are unavailable.
- **NOT_RUN:** Validated epic-readiness handoff. Every requirement has unresolved architectural dependencies.

The document remains draft, the outcome is unconfirmed, and no ADRs were written. PRD-001 also remains a proposal because its frontmatter says `draft`, despite an “Approved” change-log entry. No existing files required restoration.

The [architecture skill](/tmp/dfai-architecture-extra-a9zrt7nu/devforgeai/skills/architecture/SKILL.md) requires missing provenance to “leave validation unresolved,” so I cannot certify requirements as ready for epics.
